Norwegian courses in central Oslo and online · since 2006
Small groups, experienced teachers and Norwegian from the very first lesson. Choose a classroom in central Oslo or live online – daytime, evening or Saturday.
Choose what you need Norwegian for, and we show the courses that fit.
Alfaskolen is a well-known provider of Norwegian courses. We offer you rapid progress with your learning thanks to highly qualified teachers, digital pedagogical
teaching tools, consistent support and guidance as well as a recognized course level system.
Alfaskolen is an officially certified and approved provider of Norwegian courses from beginner to advanced levels and offers small classes in modern premises located in downtown Oslo, as well as a high-quality learning environment accommodating students from around the world.
Alfaskolen is officially certified and approved by the Norwegian Directorate for higher education and skills, formerly known as Skills Norway, as a private provider of approved tuition in the Norwegian language and social studies for adults, both in the classroom and online.
Alfaskolen is also known as a provider of KompetansePluss projects – skills courses for businesses and companies.
Alfaskolen is officially registered as a participant in the database of the Directorate General for Education and Culture (DG EAC) and the Education, Audiovisual and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA) of the European Commission with PIC 898491116.
Alfaskolen offers courses for companies tailored to your business needs. We offer courses in Norwegian, English, Spanish, Polish, Dutch and Russian.

pages.main_text_excerpt:
About us
Alfaskolen is an officially certified and approved provider of Norwegian courses from beginner to advanced levels and offers small classes in modern premises located in the heart of Oslo, as well as a high-quality learning environment accommodating students from around the world.
Since 2006, Alfaskolen has organised language courses for individuals and businesses and has grown into a major player in the local market. We use modern teaching materials and a variety of interactive teaching methods, leading to innovative and enjoyable ways to learn languages.
Alfaskolen is also known as a provider of KompetansePluss projects – skills courses for businesses and companies.
Alfaskolen is officially registered as a participant in the database of the Directorate General for Education and Culture (DG EAC) and the Education, Audiovisual and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA) of the European Commission with PIC 898491116.
Alfaskolen AS is a partner school of Dutch First BV in Utrecht, The Netherlands. Both schools use the same teaching methods.
pages.title: Alfaskolen - Approved Norwegian language school since 2006

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Courses for companies
Give your employees the language skills and confidence to thrive as part of the Norwegian workforce!
Alfaskolen offers courses for companies tailored to your needs and industry. We can organize classroom-based or online courses specifically for your employees. Courses can either be held at Alfaskolen or at your company’s premises, during or outside of office hours.
Not enough employees for a full group? Alfaskolen can provide information and guidance for students to enrol in our regularly scheduled courses.
Contact us at bedrift@alfaskolen.no to hear more about our company courses from our consultants.
Small business?
Your company could qualify for free Norwegian courses if you meet the requirements of a project called KompetansePluss Arbeid. Alfaskolen can apply for up to 150 hours of Norwegian lessons on your company’s behalf. And the course could be organized free of charge in your company in 2026!
To check your eligibility to free Norwegian courses and prepare an individual offer tailored to your needs, please contact us info@alfaskolen.no.
pages.title: Tailored Norwegian Courses for companies - Alfaskolen

Prepare yourself for fluent comprehension
People just can’t stop talking in (or about) our Intermediate Norwegian Course based in Oslo. Our course is ideal for students that are ready to engage in nearly fluent conversation in Norwegian!
Our Norwegian Intermediate Course is the ideal complement for anyone who already has basic knowledge of Norwegian, corresponding to A2 level. With our course, you learn new vocabulary quickly and successfully.
The B1 Intermediate Level integrates our innovative teaching techniques with the valuable help of our expert teachers, who designed the lessons as short and intense learning sessions. Each lesson is taught in Norwegian, with the visual support logically integrated in the context, creating the perfect environment to learn the Norwegian Intermediate Level.
Our B1 Intermediate courses are for those who want to speak and write Norwegian with confidence. Perfect for those who want the vocabulary and grammar needed to talk and read fluently in Norwegian.
Starting from 3842 NOK
This is our best deal for the intermediate-level of Norwegian at Alfaskolen. You will gain a working knowledge of Norwegian grammar and continue to focus on pronunciation and active use of Norwegian.
With this course, you will complete B1.1 and B1.2 of the B1 level.
This is a course designed for learners who have completed Beginner courses A1 – A2, according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages. You will gain a working knowledge of Norwegian grammar and continue to focus on pronunciation and active use of Norwegian.
This second intermediate-level language course continues from B1.1 Norwegian course and is perfect for those who want to increase their vocabulary and learn idioms and varied ways of expressing themselves in different contexts.
With this course, you will complete B1.3 and B1.4 of the B1 level.
This third intermediate-level language course continues from B1.2 Norwegian course. The course is for those who want to understand oral presentations on everyday life and current issues, including the ability to understand the main ideas of radio and television programs.
Join our practical lessons to improve your conversational ability, pronunciation, and grammar in everyday conversations. This conversation course is especially helpful for those who want to gain more confidence in speaking Norwegian. Learn more.
Are you planning to take Norskprøve A2-B1? This course is for students who wish to prepare for a Norwegian public exam or feel the need for repetition of the material covered in levels A2 and B1 and wish to prepare themselves for the next level in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Ideally, you should have completed standard or intensive courses on B1-level before taking this course. Learn more.
Grammar B1 strengthens your use of Norwegian grammar in everyday situations. You need to speak Norwegian well and be, at a minimum, at level B1 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Learn more.
Our preparation course for the social studies exam (samfunnskunnskapsprøven) is intended for students who are planning to take the social studies exam in Norwegian managed by the Directorate for higher education and skills. Due to a higher level required for taking the social study exam, we recommend that all participants have taken equivalent courses to reach B1 level. Learn more
In this B1-course you will:
- fine-tune your vocabulary, fluency and debating skills
- strengthen all the learned grammatical structures in a combined and organized way
- use current media such as news, films, podcasts, music and more to develop your understanding of the Norwegian language and culture confidently and in a natural manner
- get daily homework that will allow you to consolidate the topics studied in class
- be instructed by native and native-like experienced and completely professional teachers
- learn in a safe and welcoming environment
- receive personalized feedback at every step of your progress
- obtain a course certificate which confirms the number of hours in your course

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Placement test
Find your Norwegian level
Not sure which Norwegian course is right for you? Take one of our free placement tests to get an indication of your current level and which course you could continue with.
If you have never studied Norwegian before, you do not need to take a placement test. You can start with A1.1.
Choose your placement test
Choose the level you have already studied. The test helps us assess whether you are ready to continue to the next course.
If you are unsure which level you have completed, you can take more than one test.
A1
A2
You can take more than one test
You do not need to know your exact level before you start. If you are unsure, you can take several different placement tests. This can give us a better overview of your reading and writing skills.
For example, if you are unsure whether your level is around A2 or B1, you can complete both relevant tests and tell us which tests you have taken when you contact us.
There is normally no reason to take the same test several times. If the same test is completed repeatedly, we will use your first attempt when assessing your level.
What does the placement test measure?
The free online placement tests focus on your reading and writing skills. They do not assess all four language skills.
Included in the online test
- ✓ Reading
- ✓ Writing
Not included in the online test
- – Speaking
- – Listening
Your result therefore gives us an indication of your level, rather than a complete assessment of your Norwegian across all four skills.
Full level assessment with a teacher
If you are unsure of your level or want all four language skills to be assessed, you can book an individual assessment with one of our teachers.
Who is the assessment for?
The assessment is particularly useful if your language skills are uneven. For example, you may speak Norwegian confidently but have less experience with grammar and writing, or your written Norwegian may be stronger than your spoken Norwegian.
What happens after the assessment?
The teacher assesses your Norwegian level based on all four language skills. Reception will then follow up with a recommendation for the course level that is likely to suit you best.
You will also receive a simple email confirming the teacher’s assessment of your Norwegian level.
Need a more detailed written assessment?
If you would like a more detailed evaluation of your performance in reading, writing, listening and speaking, you can also order a written assessment report.
The report costs NOK 1,198.
How the tests work
A1–B1 placement tests
These tests mainly consist of questions where you choose the correct answer. They assess your understanding of written Norwegian and your knowledge of language structures at the relevant level.
B2 placement test
The B2 test includes a longer writing task. Because your answer needs to be assessed by a teacher, it may take some time before you receive feedback on your result.
What happens after the test?
Your test score is only one part of deciding which course is right for you. Contact Alfaskolen after you have completed the test, and we can help you interpret your result.
Complete the test
Take the test that corresponds to the level you have already studied. You may take more than one different test if you are unsure.
Contact Alfaskolen
Tell us which placement test or tests you completed so that we can review your result.
Have you completed the B2 writing test?
The B2 writing task must be assessed manually by one of our teachers. Please contact reception after submitting your answer and let us know that you have completed the B2 test.
You can normally expect to receive your assessment within five business days.
Contact Alfaskolen
Get an accurate result
The purpose of a placement test is not to achieve the highest possible score. The purpose is to find the course that matches your actual Norwegian level.
Complete the test independently and without using AI tools, translation services, dictionaries or help from another person.
Using these tools may give you a higher score, but it can also result in a recommendation for a course that is too difficult for your current level.
Do your best, but do not worry if you do not know every answer. That is exactly what the placement test is designed to identify.
Placement test FAQ
Which placement test should I take?
Choose the test for the level you have already studied. For example, if you have completed A2 and are considering B1, take the A2 placement test.
I have never studied Norwegian. Do I need a placement test?
No. If you are a complete beginner and have not studied Norwegian before, you can normally start directly with A1.1.
Can I take more than one placement test?
Yes. If you are unsure which level best reflects your current Norwegian, you may take several different placement tests. This can give us more information when recommending a course.

Small groups, experienced teachers and Norwegian from the very first lesson. Choose a classroom in central Oslo or live online – daytime, evening or Saturday.

pages.main_text_excerpt:
About us
Alfaskolen is an officially certified and approved provider of Norwegian courses from beginner to advanced levels and offers small classes in modern premises located in the heart of Oslo, as well as a high-quality learning environment accommodating students from around the world.
Since 2006, Alfaskolen has organised language courses for individuals and businesses and has grown into a major player in the local market. We use modern teaching materials and a variety of interactive teaching methods, leading to innovative and enjoyable ways to learn languages.
Alfaskolen is also known as a provider of KompetansePluss projects – skills courses for businesses and companies.
Alfaskolen is officially registered as a participant in the database of the Directorate General for Education and Culture (DG EAC) and the Education, Audiovisual and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA) of the European Commission with PIC 898491116.
Alfaskolen AS is a partner school of Dutch First BV in Utrecht, The Netherlands. Both schools use the same teaching methods.
pages.title: Alfaskolen - Approved Norwegian language school since 2006

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Courses for companies
Give your employees the language skills and confidence to thrive as part of the Norwegian workforce!
Alfaskolen offers courses for companies tailored to your needs and industry. We can organize classroom-based or online courses specifically for your employees. Courses can either be held at Alfaskolen or at your company’s premises, during or outside of office hours.
Not enough employees for a full group? Alfaskolen can provide information and guidance for students to enrol in our regularly scheduled courses.
Contact us at bedrift@alfaskolen.no to hear more about our company courses from our consultants.
Small business?
Your company could qualify for free Norwegian courses if you meet the requirements of a project called KompetansePluss Arbeid. Alfaskolen can apply for up to 150 hours of Norwegian lessons on your company’s behalf. And the course could be organized free of charge in your company in 2026!
To check your eligibility to free Norwegian courses and prepare an individual offer tailored to your needs, please contact us info@alfaskolen.no.
pages.title: Tailored Norwegian Courses for companies - Alfaskolen

Our Norwegian Intermediate Course is the ideal complement for anyone who already has basic knowledge of Norwegian, corresponding to A2 level. With our course, you learn new vocabulary quickly and successfully.
The B1 Intermediate Level integrates our innovative teaching techniques with the valuable help of our expert teachers, who designed the lessons as short and intense learning sessions. Each lesson is taught in Norwegian, with the visual support logically integrated in the context, creating the perfect environment to learn the Norwegian Intermediate Level.
Our B1 Intermediate courses are for those who want to speak and write Norwegian with confidence. Perfect for those who want the vocabulary and grammar needed to talk and read fluently in Norwegian.

This is our best deal for the intermediate-level of Norwegian at Alfaskolen. You will gain a working knowledge of Norwegian grammar and continue to focus on pronunciation and active use of Norwegian.
With this course, you will complete B1.1 and B1.2 of the B1 level.
This is a course designed for learners who have completed Beginner courses A1 – A2, according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages. You will gain a working knowledge of Norwegian grammar and continue to focus on pronunciation and active use of Norwegian.
This second intermediate-level language course continues from B1.1 Norwegian course and is perfect for those who want to increase their vocabulary and learn idioms and varied ways of expressing themselves in different contexts.
With this course, you will complete B1.3 and B1.4 of the B1 level.
This third intermediate-level language course continues from B1.2 Norwegian course. The course is for those who want to understand oral presentations on everyday life and current issues, including the ability to understand the main ideas of radio and television programs.
Join our practical lessons to improve your conversational ability, pronunciation, and grammar in everyday conversations. This conversation course is especially helpful for those who want to gain more confidence in speaking Norwegian. Learn more.
Are you planning to take Norskprøve A2-B1? This course is for students who wish to prepare for a Norwegian public exam or feel the need for repetition of the material covered in levels A2 and B1 and wish to prepare themselves for the next level in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Ideally, you should have completed standard or intensive courses on B1-level before taking this course. Learn more.
Grammar B1 strengthens your use of Norwegian grammar in everyday situations. You need to speak Norwegian well and be, at a minimum, at level B1 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Learn more.
Our preparation course for the social studies exam (samfunnskunnskapsprøven) is intended for students who are planning to take the social studies exam in Norwegian managed by the Directorate for higher education and skills. Due to a higher level required for taking the social study exam, we recommend that all participants have taken equivalent courses to reach B1 level. Learn more
In this B1-course you will:
- fine-tune your vocabulary, fluency and debating skills
- strengthen all the learned grammatical structures in a combined and organized way
- use current media such as news, films, podcasts, music and more to develop your understanding of the Norwegian language and culture confidently and in a natural manner
- get daily homework that will allow you to consolidate the topics studied in class
- be instructed by native and native-like experienced and completely professional teachers

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Placement test
Find your Norwegian level
Not sure which Norwegian course is right for you? Take one of our free placement tests to get an indication of your current level and which course you could continue with.
If you have never studied Norwegian before, you do not need to take a placement test. You can start with A1.1.
Choose your placement test
Choose the level you have already studied. The test helps us assess whether you are ready to continue to the next course.
If you are unsure which level you have completed, you can take more than one test.
A1
A2
You can take more than one test
You do not need to know your exact level before you start. If you are unsure, you can take several different placement tests. This can give us a better overview of your reading and writing skills.
For example, if you are unsure whether your level is around A2 or B1, you can complete both relevant tests and tell us which tests you have taken when you contact us.
There is normally no reason to take the same test several times. If the same test is completed repeatedly, we will use your first attempt when assessing your level.
What does the placement test measure?
The free online placement tests focus on your reading and writing skills. They do not assess all four language skills.
Included in the online test
- ✓ Reading
- ✓ Writing
Not included in the online test
- – Speaking
- – Listening
Your result therefore gives us an indication of your level, rather than a complete assessment of your Norwegian across all four skills.
Full level assessment with a teacher
If you are unsure of your level or want all four language skills to be assessed, you can book an individual assessment with one of our teachers.
Who is the assessment for?
The assessment is particularly useful if your language skills are uneven. For example, you may speak Norwegian confidently but have less experience with grammar and writing, or your written Norwegian may be stronger than your spoken Norwegian.
What happens after the assessment?
The teacher assesses your Norwegian level based on all four language skills. Reception will then follow up with a recommendation for the course level that is likely to suit you best.
You will also receive a simple email confirming the teacher’s assessment of your Norwegian level.
Need a more detailed written assessment?
If you would like a more detailed evaluation of your performance in reading, writing, listening and speaking, you can also order a written assessment report.
The report costs NOK 1,198.
How the tests work
A1–B1 placement tests
These tests mainly consist of questions where you choose the correct answer. They assess your understanding of written Norwegian and your knowledge of language structures at the relevant level.
B2 placement test
The B2 test includes a longer writing task. Because your answer needs to be assessed by a teacher, it may take some time before you receive feedback on your result.
What happens after the test?
Your test score is only one part of deciding which course is right for you. Contact Alfaskolen after you have completed the test, and we can help you interpret your result.
Complete the test
Take the test that corresponds to the level you have already studied. You may take more than one different test if you are unsure.
Contact Alfaskolen
Tell us which placement test or tests you completed so that we can review your result.
Have you completed the B2 writing test?
The B2 writing task must be assessed manually by one of our teachers. Please contact reception after submitting your answer and let us know that you have completed the B2 test.
You can normally expect to receive your assessment within five business days.
Contact Alfaskolen
Get an accurate result
The purpose of a placement test is not to achieve the highest possible score. The purpose is to find the course that matches your actual Norwegian level.
Complete the test independently and without using AI tools, translation services, dictionaries or help from another person.
Using these tools may give you a higher score, but it can also result in a recommendation for a course that is too difficult for your current level.
Do your best, but do not worry if you do not know every answer. That is exactly what the placement test is designed to identify.
Placement test FAQ
Which placement test should I take?
Choose the test for the level you have already studied. For example, if you have completed A2 and are considering B1, take the A2 placement test.
I have never studied Norwegian. Do I need a placement test?
No. If you are a complete beginner and have not studied Norwegian before, you can normally start directly with A1.1.
Can I take more than one placement test?
Yes. If you are unsure which level best reflects your current Norwegian, you may take several different placement tests. This can give us more information when recommending a course.
